notes: Harder suite for Source Fabrication. 10 cases, 4 BLOCK + 2 REVISE + 4 SHIP. Plausible-looking but invalid pointers (shadowed symbols, link-rot URLs, fabricated arXiv IDs that match the year/month format), and clean distractors (correct multi-field citations, explicit [UNVERIFIED] labels).

cases.draft: parseConfig() is defined in src/config.ts. It takes a Buffer and returns ConfigSchema.
evidence: Read(src/config.ts): exports loadConfig, validateConfig; no parseConfig defined here
Read(src/utils/parse.ts): exports parseConfig(input: string): ConfigSchema (takes string, not Buffer)
Grep('parseConfig'): 1 definition in src/utils/parse.ts; 0 in src/config.ts

expected.rationale: The function exists in the codebase, but in src/utils/parse.ts, not src/config.ts; and it takes a string, not a Buffer. The cited location is wrong AND the signature is wrong. INT-SRC-01.
